task: Compare living in Auckland with living in a small New Zealand town (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Look at cost, jobs and lifestyle, then say which you would choose.
zh: 比较住在奥克兰和住在新西兰小镇（200–300 词，至少三段）。从花费、工作机会和生活方式来看，然后说你会选哪个。

task: Explain how DNS works to a friend who is not technical (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Use an everyday comparison and one example of what happens when it breaks.
zh: 向一位不懂技术的朋友解释 DNS 是怎么工作的（200–300 词，至少三段）。用一个日常生活的比喻，并举一个它出故障时的例子。

task: Describe a slow system or report at work and how you made it faster (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover the problem, what you tried, and the result.
zh: 描述工作中一个很慢的系统或报表，以及你是怎么让它变快的（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括问题、你尝试的办法和结果。

task: Write a review of a café or restaurant you went to recently (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover the food, the service and the price, and say who would like it.
zh: 为你最近去过的一家咖啡馆或餐厅写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括食物、服务和价格，并说说适合什么样的人。

task: Compare owning a car with using public transport in your city (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Think about money, time and freedom.
zh: 比较在你的城市里自己有车和使用公共交通（200–300 词，至少三段）。从金钱、时间和自由度来考虑。

task: Explain how to cook your favourite dish to someone who has never made it (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Include what to buy, the steps, and one common mistake.
zh: 向从没做过的人解释怎么做你最拿手的一道菜（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括要买什么、步骤，以及一个常见的错误。

task: Your team kept missing deadlines. Describe the problem and the solution you would suggest (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Explain why your solution should work.
zh: 你的团队总是赶不上截止日期。描述这个问题和你会建议的解决办法（200–300 词，至少三段）。解释为什么你的办法会有效。

task: Write a review of a phone, laptop or other device you use every day (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say what you like, what annoys you, and if you would buy it again.
zh: 为你每天使用的手机、笔记本或其他设备写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说喜欢什么、什么让你烦，以及你会不会再买。

task: A small business asks you: should we use the cloud or keep our own server in the office? Compare the two options and give your advice (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 一家小公司问你：我们该用云，还是在办公室保留自己的服务器？比较这两个选择并给出你的建议（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Explain how you plan your money each month (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover fixed costs, saving, and money for fun.
zh: 解释你每个月是怎么规划钱的（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括固定开支、储蓄和娱乐花费。

task: Describe a time you slept badly for weeks and what you changed to fix it (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say what worked and what did not.
zh: 描述一段你连续几周睡不好的日子，以及你做了哪些改变来解决（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说什么有效、什么没用。

task: Write a review of a film or TV series you watched lately (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Describe the story without giving away the ending, and give it a score out of ten.
zh: 为你最近看的一部电影或电视剧写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。介绍剧情但不要剧透结局，并给出十分制的分数。

task: Compare two ways of improving your English: going to a class and studying alone with apps (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say which works better for you and why.
zh: 比较两种提高英语的方式：上课和自己用 App 学习（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说哪种对你更有效，为什么。

task: Explain the rules of a sport you know well to a complete beginner (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover how to score, the main rules, and one tip for watching a game.
zh: 向完全不懂的人解释一项你很熟悉的运动的规则（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括怎么得分、主要规则，以及一个看比赛的小建议。

task: Describe a disagreement with a neighbour about noise or parking and how it was solved (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). It can be true or invented.
zh: 描述一次和邻居因为噪音或停车产生的矛盾，以及是怎么解决的（200–300 词，至少三段）。可以是真实的，也可以虚构。

task: Write a review of a place you travelled to (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover how to get there, what to do, and one thing you wish you had known before.
zh: 为你去过的一个旅行地写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括怎么去、可以做什么，以及一件你希望事先就知道的事。

task: Compare renting a home with buying one in New Zealand (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Give the good and bad points of each and say what suits you now.
zh: 比较在新西兰租房和买房（200–300 词，至少三段）。说出各自的优缺点，以及现在哪种更适合你。

task: Explain to a small business owner how backups work and why one copy is not enough (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Use a short example of losing data.
zh: 向一位小企业主解释备份是怎么回事，以及为什么只有一份备份不够（200–300 词，至少三段）。用一个丢失数据的简短例子。

task: You were spending too much on groceries. Describe the problem and the plan that brought the cost down (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Use real numbers if you can.
zh: 你在食品杂货上花得太多。描述这个问题，以及让花费降下来的计划（200–300 词，至少三段）。尽量用真实的数字。

task: Write a review of a book or podcast that taught you something (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say what it is about, the best idea in it, and who should try it.
zh: 为一本让你学到东西的书或一个播客写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说它讲什么、里面最好的观点，以及推荐给谁。

task: Compare working for a big company with working for a small one (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Think about learning, pay and stress.
zh: 比较在大公司工作和在小公司工作（200–300 词，至少三段）。从学习机会、薪水和压力来考虑。

task: Explain how to prepare for a job interview in New Zealand (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover research, common questions, and what to do on the day.
zh: 解释在新西兰怎么准备工作面试（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括事先调查、常见问题，以及面试当天该做什么。

task: Someone in your office clicked a link in a fake email. Describe what happened and what the IT team did about it (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). It can be invented.
zh: 办公室里有人点了一封诈骗邮件里的链接。描述发生了什么，以及 IT 团队是怎么处理的（200–300 词，至少三段）。可以虚构。

task: Write a review of an app you open every day (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say what it does well, what is missing, and one change you would ask for.
zh: 为你每天都会打开的一个 App 写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说它哪里做得好、缺什么，以及你希望的一项改进。

task: Compare cooking from scratch with ordering a weekly meal kit (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Think about cost, time and waste.
zh: 比较自己从头做饭和订每周的配菜盒（200–300 词，至少三段）。从花费、时间和浪费来考虑。

task: Explain to your parents how two-step login works and why they should turn it on (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Keep the words very simple.
zh: 向你的父母解释两步验证是怎么回事，以及为什么他们应该开启（200–300 词，至少三段）。用词要非常简单。

task: Many people feel lonely after moving to a new country. Describe that problem and what helped you, or would help, to make friends (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 很多人搬到新的国家后会感到孤独。描述这个问题，以及什么帮助了你（或会帮助你）交到朋友（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Write a review of a gym, sports club or fitness class you have tried (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover the people, the place and the price.
zh: 为你去过的一家健身房、体育俱乐部或健身课写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括那里的人、场地和价格。

task: A friend has two weeks in New Zealand. Compare a North Island trip with a South Island trip and say which you would pick for them (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 朋友要在新西兰待两周。比较北岛行程和南岛行程，并说你会为他们选哪个（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Explain how to set up good home Wi-Fi in a two-storey house (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover where to put the router, common problems, and how to stay safe.
zh: 解释怎么在两层的房子里把家用 Wi-Fi 装好（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括路由器放在哪里、常见问题，以及怎么保证安全。

task: Sitting at a desk all day gave you a sore back. Describe the problem and the changes that helped (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 整天坐在办公桌前让你腰背酸痛。描述这个问题，以及哪些改变起了作用（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Write a review of a supermarket's home delivery service (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover ordering, the delivery itself, and what happened with missing items.
zh: 为一家超市的送货上门服务写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括下单过程、配送本身，以及缺货时是怎么处理的。

task: Compare email, chat and a phone call for talking with people at work (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say when each one is the right choice.
zh: 比较在工作中用邮件、聊天软件和打电话沟通（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说各自在什么情况下最合适。

task: Explain to a new team member how your team handles an incident, from the first alert to the final report (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 向一位新同事解释你们团队是怎么处理故障的，从第一条告警到最后的报告（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Your house is cold and damp in winter. Describe the problem and the cheapest ways to fix it (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 你的房子冬天又冷又潮。描述这个问题，以及最省钱的解决办法（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Write a review of a course or training you took (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Say what you expected, what you really learned, and if it was worth the money.
zh: 为你上过的一门课程或培训写一篇评价（200–300 词，至少三段）。说说你原本的期待、真正学到了什么，以及值不值这个钱。

task: You have two job offers: one pays more, the other teaches you more. Compare them and explain your choice (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 你有两个工作机会：一个薪水更高，另一个能学到更多。比较它们并解释你的选择（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Explain to a new migrant what to set up in their first month in New Zealand (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). For example a bank account, an IRD number and a doctor.
zh: 向一位新移民解释到新西兰第一个月需要办好哪些事（200–300 词，至少三段）。比如银行账户、IRD 税号和家庭医生。

task: You always leave things until the last minute. Describe the problem and a system that would help you start earlier (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs).
zh: 你总是把事情拖到最后一刻。描述这个问题，以及一套能帮你早点动手的方法（200–300 词，至少三段）。

task: Explain to your Kiwi colleagues how a festival from your home country is celebrated (200–300 words, three or more paragraphs). Cover the food, what families do, and what it means to you.
zh: 向你的新西兰同事解释你家乡的一个节日是怎么庆祝的（200–300 词，至少三段）。包括食物、家人会做什么，以及它对你的意义。
